item.title: 20 Essential Microsoft Excel Tips & Tricks Every Analyst Should Know
item.description:
20 Essential Microsoft Excel Tips & Tricks Every Analyst Should Know

Microsoft Excel remains one of the most powerful tools for data analysis, reporting, financial modeling, auditing, and business intelligence. While most users know basic formulas like SUM() and AVERAGE(), Excel contains many powerful features that can dramatically improve productivity.

This guide explains twenty practical Excel tips with examples, use cases, advantages, shortcuts, and best practices.

1. Create a Dynamic Drop-down List

What is it?

A dynamic drop-down automatically updates whenever new items are added to the source list.

item.title: Restructuring Multi-Year Excel Data into a Single Year-Wise Table with Microsoft Excel
item.description:
Restructuring Multi-Year Excel Data into a Single Year-Wise Table with Microsoft Excel

Business reports often store data for different Financial Years (FY) in separate tables within the same worksheet or across multiple worksheets. While this layout is convenient for preparing annual reports, it becomes difficult when you need to analyze trends, create dashboards, generate PivotTables, or import data into Power BI.

In this conversation, the objective was simple:

Convert multiple FY-wise tables into a single consolidated table and arrange the data year-wise.

item.title: ChatGPT for Excel: 50 Powerful Prompts, Practical Examples, and Real-World Use Cases
item.description:
ChatGPT for Excel: 50 Powerful Prompts, Practical Examples, and Real-World Use Cases

Excel has evolved from being a spreadsheet application into one of the world’s most powerful data analysis tools. Combined with ChatGPT, Excel becomes even more productive. Instead of spending hours searching for formulas or debugging VBA code, you can simply describe what you need and let ChatGPT generate formulas, explain functions, write macros, or suggest better ways to analyze your data.

item.title: Building a Practical GST Compliance Audit Framework: From Raw Records to Professional Audit Reports
item.description:
Building a Practical GST Compliance Audit Framework

Over the course of this project, the goal was not simply to prepare another GST audit report. The objective was to build a repeatable audit methodology that can be used by government auditors, internal auditors, chartered accountants, and finance professionals for conducting GST compliance audits efficiently.

The work evolved from preparing simple audit observations into developing a structured audit framework, reusable templates, reconciliation tools, reporting formats, and workflow automation.
